description: Sets the daily calorie and macro targets, and optionally a target for any other nutrient (the keys in overview.foodNutrients): a ceiling for the ones to limit, such as sodiumMg, cholesterolMg, sugarG, saturatedFatG or caffeineMg, and an amount to reach for the rest, such as potassiumMg, fiberG or calciumMg. nutrients left out keeps the ones already set; {} clears them.
name: trainrec_set_targets
title: Set daily targets
